text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-women panel is not evidence of bias on its own. Panels skew by whoever is available in HR, senior management, and the hiring line; four people is also a small sample. If you raise it, you'll be read as inferring discrimination from sex alone — exactly the reasoning you'd object to if applied to you — and it will discredit any legitimate complaint.

Note also that "head of group" is a leadership post. Client relationships, commercial judgement, and staff management often outweigh extra years of design work, so her profile isn't implausible.

What *is* worth pursuing: the unanswered request. Chase it in writing, ask for the scoring criteria and your scores against them, and set a deadline. Substance over inference.
